marquee_header: To change society, we must first change ourselves. Personal growth leads to collective progress.
main_header: Shree Char Pargana Prajapati Samaj, Surat
description: With the cooperation of all of you, we are extremely happy and excited to launch the website of Shri Char Pargana Prajapati Samaj, Surat. Time is stretched in today's fast-paced era. A person who understands the value of time must realize great value. Everyone needs to plan their time. Spending some time in this planning for our society is necessary for the upliftment of every society. A humble request to all to come forward in the work of the society. The indomitable hope that we light the lamp by lamp, flame by flame and lead the society on the path of light, we all climb the peaks of success.
description-extra: Forget what you got from the society, what you gave to the society is what matters. The giver is greater than the taker. The taker's hand is down and the giver's hand is up is the fearless truth. There is no past without Naat. Jati Ganga is a holy festival. Dive into it and feel the coolness...
